# Dockform — full documentation map

> Same project summary as https://dockform.io/llms.txt — this file lists every published doc URL with a short hint.

Base URL: https://dockform.io/
Repository: https://github.com/gcstr/dockform

---

## Introduction

- [What is Dockform?](https://dockform.io/introduction/what_is_dockform/) — product overview, v0.8 highlights, use cases, why Dockform exists.
- [Getting started](https://dockform.io/introduction/getting_started/) — install and first steps.
- [End-to-end tutorial](https://dockform.io/introduction/tutorial/) — guided walkthrough.
- [Migrating to v0.8](https://dockform.io/introduction/migration_v08/) — upgrade notes for the v0.8 manifest and workflow changes.
- [Why not X?](https://dockform.io/introduction/why_not_x/) — comparisons and positioning vs alternatives.

## Manifest file

- [Overview](https://dockform.io/manifest/overview/) — manifest concepts and structure.
- [Stacks](https://dockform.io/manifest/stacks/) — defining and organizing Compose stacks.
- [Interpolation](https://dockform.io/manifest/interpolation/) — variables and templating in the manifest.
- [Volumes](https://dockform.io/manifest/volumes/) — declarative volume lifecycle.
- [Filesets](https://dockform.io/manifest/filesets/) — managed files on disk alongside stacks.
- [Networks](https://dockform.io/manifest/networks/) — external and declarative networks.
- [Secrets — overview](https://dockform.io/manifest/secrets/) — secrets model in Dockform.
- [Secrets — age with SOPS](https://dockform.io/manifest/secrets/age_with_sops/) — encrypting secrets with age and SOPS.
- [Secrets — GnuPG with SOPS](https://dockform.io/manifest/secrets/gpg_with_sops/) — encrypting secrets with GPG and SOPS.

## Guides (more)

- [Best practices](https://dockform.io/more/best_practices/) — recommended patterns.
- [Snapshots & restore](https://dockform.io/more/snapshots_and_restore/) — volume snapshots and restore flows.
- [Dashboard](https://dockform.io/more/dashboard/) — using the Dockform dashboard.
- [Debugging](https://dockform.io/more/debugging/) — troubleshooting and diagnostics.

## CLI reference — top-level

- [dockform](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform/) — root command and global usage.

## CLI reference — lifecycle & stacks

- [apply](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_apply/) — apply manifest to targets.
- [plan](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_plan/) — show planned changes.
- [destroy](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_destroy/) — tear down managed resources.
- [validate](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_validate/) — validate manifest.
- [doctor](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_doctor/) — environment checks.
- [compose](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_compose/) — Compose-related commands.
- [compose render](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_compose_render/) — render Compose output.
- [version](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_version/) — print version.

## CLI reference — manifest & init

- [init](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_init/) — scaffold a project.
- [manifest](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_manifest/) — manifest operations.
- [manifest render](https://dockform.io/cli/dockform_manifest_render/) — render manifest views.
